title: Foundations of Mathematics Education III: Curriculum
department: Teaching and Learning, Policy and Leadership
description:
Prerequisite: Admitted to Mathematics Education Doctoral Program; or permission of EDUC-Teaching and Learning, Policy and Leadership department.
Credit only granted for: EDCI753 or TLPL712.
Formerly: EDCI753. The study of curriculum in mathematics and research on curriculum. The relationship of mathematics and school mathematics; the forms, purposes,development, and evaluation of mathematics curricula.
